title: createTable on PostgreSQL with two schemas: each client creates its own table, and a same-named table elsewhere stays untouched
proves: two <database> clients on one server have their own schema in conf/*.env.properties; createTable creates dm_s53_lines once in each schema, without a DDL step
a table of the same name in the default schema (public) is not found, reflected or changed by either client
a second run finds both tables in their schemas and upserts the same rows again
Build creates no table: it proves the rows and each declared sink, and the sinks of the two clients stay apart by client id although the entity name is the same
this project needs the PostgreSQL service: it runs in the external-service test job
